item.title: Ep 2: Poland calls a fire fifty kilometres from Warsaw sabotage against Ukraine’s internet.
item.description: Omni View Europe Poland calls a fire fifty kilometres from Warsaw sabotage against Ukraine’s internet. What You Need to Know: Poland’s deputy prime minister calls a fire at a Starlink station fifty kilometres south of Warsaw deliberate sabotage against internet links used in part by Ukraine, while Denmark’s intelligence service expects Russian hybrid attacks to escalate and still calls a direct military attack highly unlikely. ... item.title: Ep 1: Italy’s Senate approved a plan to restart nuclear power nearly 40 years after a referendum…
item.description: Omni View Europe Italy’s Senate approved a plan to restart nuclear power nearly 40 years after a referendum closed the reactors. What You Need to Know: Italy’s upper house gave final approval to legislation that sets a 12-month deadline for decrees to relaunch nuclear generation and creates an independent regulator. Germany published a roadmap that for the first time makes an explicit commitment to phase out fossil fuels by 2045 while raising renewable electricity targets. ...
